paras_en: Hi, my name's Nerissa, and I'm from the Philippines. My question is, where does your family live?

My family lives in Cavite. It is an hour away from Manila. The capital city of the Philippines. Cavite is a small province. Before there were many fields and farms. Now there are buildings and malls. More people live and visit here. My family likes it because we can go to different places. There is a famous tourist park in Cavita. It is known for its cool weather and nice view of a volcano. We go there when there's a special occasion, like birthdays or holidays.
What about you? Where does your family live?
Hello, my name is Rocio and I am from El Salvador. My question is, what fruits do you like? What fruits do I like?

I like bananas. I like mangoes. I like watermelon. I like pineapples, but I love grapes. I love them when they are really sweet. I don't like sour fruits, like lemons or grapefruits when they are green, like a green apple or green grapes. In El Salvador, we have many tropical fruits.
And you, what fruits do you like? What fruits are common in your country?
Hi, everybody, this is Todd, your teacher from ELLLO. And right now I am at my favorite place and this is a beach near my house where I live and teach and work in Japan.

And I love this beach for many reasons. One, there aren't many people on the beach, so usually this beach is really quiet and there's not a lot going on. There's many trees near the beach. There's a beautiful forest, so you can kind of take a walk in there. And the beach usually is really clean. There isn't much pollution, there isn't much noise, although sometimes you can hear a plane because many planes land by the airport. I guess we can't see one now, but there are many planes in this area, and it's just a nice place. There's a lot of space, there's a lot of light, and it's just a really peaceful place. And so because of that, I really enjoy it. And there's many things you can do here. You can take a walk, you can relax on the beach, you can listen to the waves. It's just really, really peaceful. So for that reason, I love this beach. It's my favorite place in.
Hello, my name is Elizabeth. I am from the United States, and my question is, who will you see tonight or tomorrow?

Tonight I am going to see my grandparents. I haven't seen them in a couple of months, so I'm going to drive over to their house tonight. They live about two hours away. I'm going to take my dog, and today is actually my grandmother's 82nd birthday, so I'm going to be able to celebrate with them. I think we're going to go out to eat to a nice restaurant and hopefully we will have birthday cake and my family will be there, my aunts, uncles, and cousins to help celebrate. And then tomorrow my grandmother really enjoys shopping, so I think I'll go shopping with her. My grand also enjoys walking, so we'll plan to walk the dogs together.
So I have a dog and they have a little poodle, and that is who I'm going to see tonight and tomorrow.
Hi, I'm Elise, and I'm going to talk about the days of the week. On Monday morning, I go to the supermarket and buy all the groceries for the week.

On Tuesday morning, I go to yoga class. It's very relaxing. On Tuesday afternoon, I teach English from two till 10:00 PM On Wednesday morning, I clean the house. It's a bit boring, but very important. In the afternoon, I take my children to the park. On Thursday morning, I have a Spanish class. We have a new teacher right now, his name is Mr. Sanchez. On Thursday evening, we often play board games with my family. On Friday morning, I teach English again, and on Friday afternoon I go to the park or I visit my mother. On Saturday, I often meet with a friend, usually in the afternoon to drink coffee. Sometimes on Saturday night I go to see a play and on Sunday we go to the park or we go to the gym.
What's your favorite day of the week?

title_en: What did you do over the weekend?
paras_en: Hi everyone, I'm Jill and I'm from Australia. And my question today is what did you do over the weekend?

So last weekend I actually had a very special weekend. I took my mom on a trip to Tedra Island. We took a boat down to Tedra Island and we spent the whole weekend going on lots of big walks and eating lots of really good seafood. We ate lots of abalone and lots of sashimi, which was super fresh and delicious. And we went on lots of hikes. They have a beautiful mountain in the center of the island and all around it is big forest. And so we hiked through the forest and we saw lots of beautiful colors that are happening right now because it is autumn.

In Korea, we also went to a massage shop where we were able to sleep a little and have massages, and we drank lots and lots of good coffee, which was surprising because I wasn't expecting that we had really good weather, which was very lucky because it can be a little bit cold. But yeah, I had a really lovely weekend.
And what about you? What did you do over the weekend?

title_en: What is on your schedule today?
paras_en: Hi. My name is Nerry, and I am from Belize. My question for today is, what is on your schedule today?

The only thing on my schedule today is gym time. I am still on my holiday vacation, so there is not much for me to do. I cleaned my house this morning, and now I am doing some work on my computer. When I'm finished with this, then I will be going to the gym. I like going to the gym. The gym makes me happy. And I like days like today when I do not have to work very hard.
My question for you is, what do you have on your schedule today?

title_en: What are some tips in language learning?
paras_en: Hi, I'm Ozlem. I'm from Turkey. And here is my question: what are some tips in language learning?

I have been an ESL teacher for over 20 years, and I would like to say a few things about language learning. I always see people trying to find a shortcut in language learning. Yes, you can have a shortcut in the sense of time, but I don't believe you can have a shortcut in the sense of effort. So, number one, you should find the reason: why do you want to learn this language? For example, if you want to speak fluently, you should focus on speaking and listening activities. I generally see people complaining about the amount of time they have spent and have no result at the end. But when we look closer at their studies, we see that they have not spent enough time in that specific skill they want. And secondly, you should follow a system. If you follow a system, if you have a system, and thirdly, if you have fun, this is very important, you will definitely learn the language. So have a system and have fun. Love what you are doing. Thank you. See you later. Bye.

title_en: Intermediate English - 2 - What is your dream job?
paras_en: What is my dream job?

Okay, so my dream job is to become a successful business woman. I don't call it a dream job, I just call it a goal. This is my goal to become successful business woman. But apart from this, I love trading a lot. I would die to become pro at scalping trading. This is what I'm actually willing to be doing in the next few months, learning more about trading and scalping, and this is what I'm willing to be successful at one day, you know. So, I always imagine myself, I don't mind if I see it the whole day in front of my screen doing scalping, learning new things, learning more about it.
So yeah, this is actually what I'm willing to be doing in the next few months and few years. So, yeah, that's it.

title_en: Intermediate English - 3 - Is it important for you to have a car?
paras_en: Hi, my name's Rachel, and I'm from Australia. My question is, is it important for you to have a car?

So, where I live at the moment, there is a lot of public transport, so having a car is not a huge thing for me. Obviously, it would be nice if I had the option to drive around, could be a bit easier, but no. Overall, as long as I have good public transport, it doesn't affect my life that much, and it's actually better for the environment, so I'm okay with it.

title_en: Intermediate English - 4 - Do you have a car?
paras_en: Hello everybody. This is Antti from Finland. I'm from Central Finland. My question for elllo.org today is, do you have a car?

And my answer is, yes, I do. I do have a car, and my car is a Hyundai I-20. It's blue, and I need to drive my car every day cause I need to go to school by car. And my school is about 15 kilometers from my home, and there are no bus connections from my home to my school. I also have a bike, and I ride my bike only in summer, and it's more like a hobby.
So what about you?
Do you have a car or would you like to have a car or do you have a bike?
Okay, bye-bye.

title_en: Intermediate English - 5 - Have you ever had a beloved pet?
paras_en: Have you ever had a beloved pet?

I've actually always been a dog person and I've always wanted a dog, but I never really got one up until now. So now I have, I would like to say small puppy, but he is not that small. He's Belgian Shepherd, a Malinois, and he's becoming very big, which is an increasing problem in our household.

But to be honest with you, I never really understood people who had pets, and I never understood how they could love a pet so much. But now that I have him, his name is Maki, by the way, like the sushi. Now that I have Maki in my life, I can definitely understand that you can love an animal so, so much. And if it was up to me, I would spend all of my waking hours with him, but I can't. So I just have to be at peace with that. But yeah, he is a very, very beloved dog in our house.
